brief: Five distinct Greek document item cutouts replace shared or placeholder art: a guard wax tablet, burial papyrus folio, pyre clay record, Marathon wax diptych and bronze-sealed writ. Material and silhouette identify each document while all writing faces remain blank.
art_direction_feedback: Match the established Greek item family with warm upper-left amber light, deep subdued blue-indigo self-shadow, matte painterly texture and worn natural materials.
Use complete square transparent cutouts for cards and floor items, with generous outer margins and a quiet lower card-name area.
Keep materials and silhouettes distinct at small display sizes. The Guard and Marathon records remain wax; the sealed palace writ remains visibly sealed.
No readable or unreadable text, pseudoletters, glyphs, ruled rows, sigils or pictorial emblems. Plain material grain and natural wear are allowed.
No people, hands, scenery, floor, cast ground shadow, extra props or painted background.

Preserve exact final prompts and every earlier prompt used in the reference chain. Generated references are identified by generation ID and PNG hash; repository references are pinned to the base commit.

generation_history.prompt:
Create one finished inventory-item illustration for CosyWorld's Greek drama. This is a new object, not a copy of either supplied object.

REFERENCE ROLES: Reference 1, decree.png, is ONLY a reference for the game's hand-painted natural-material rendering, aged surfaces, amber highlights and richly shaded depth. Do not copy its ornate rollers, shape, red seal, ornament, any marks, or any lettering. Reference 2, funeral-cloth.png, is ONLY a reference for the tactile plain undyed linen and soft warmly lit pigment handling; do not include the cloth bundle itself. Match these references' painterly storybook realism: tangible worn material, fine dry-brush grain, soft irregular pigment edges, warm amber upper-left lighting, restrained ochre/ivory highlights and deep desaturated blue-indigo shadows within the object. This must look like a painted game item, not a flat vector icon, glossy 3D render, or photographic product shot.

COMPOSITION AND ALPHA: A square 1254 by 1254 RGBA canvas with a genuinely transparent background. Exactly one complete, isolated object, shown slightly from above in a readable three-quarter view. Keep the entire object including every fiber, tie end and worn edge between x=14% and x=86%, and between y=8% and y=75% of the whole canvas. Place its visual center near x=50%, y=42%. Leave at least the entire bottom 22% of the image absolutely empty and transparent for the card name. Do not zoom in or crop any part. Preserve generous transparent breathing room on all four sides. Every gap around or through the object is truly transparent, with no opaque fill. No floor, pedestal, cast ground shadow, ambient halo, drop shadow, vignette, backdrop, scenery, smoke, particles or checkerboard pattern. Natural self-shadow on the object itself is welcome. Bold, clear silhouette and broad material masses must remain identifiable when the whole square is displayed at 150 pixels.

ABSOLUTELY TEXTLESS: All surfaces are intentionally blank. No letters, words, numbers, handwriting, unreadable scribbles, pseudoletters, glyphs, runes, ruled lines, repeated rows, tally marks, symbols, sigils, stamps, embossed motifs, pictorial emblems, logos or watermark anywhere. Only unstructured natural material grain and irregular wear. No people, faces, hands, body parts, weapons, decorative props, modern stationery, or UI.

OBJECT — BURIAL ACCOUNT: This portable account belongs to the household's burial rite: the grave was dug, cloth and oil were brought, and witnesses saw it. Express its humble, hand-carried nature only through the material and silhouette; do not illustrate the story and do not put writing on it. Paint a single loose, partly unrolled pale papyrus folio, a supple ivory sheet with an irregular fibrous edge and a softly curled upper edge, one lower corner naturally turned under. Its overall silhouette is taller than it is wide, gently tilted, airy and distinctly made of thin pale papyrus. The blank broad central face catches warm light; the thin curled lip and underside show cool indigo-umber self-shadow. Subtle dusty wear, faint creases and papyrus fibers are natural and randomly oriented, never arranged in lines or resembling writing. A simple narrow undyed linen tie loosely loops around one edge of the folio, with a small plain knot and short frayed ends, all within the required safe area. The sheet is partly unfurled enough to read clearly as a blank record sheet rather than a tightly rolled scroll. No wooden or metal rollers, no frame, no wax or official seal, no ribbon badge, no ornament. Keep it light, intimate, plain, and materially distinct from a thick clay tablet.
